'''Ebrahi's loyalists''' were a group that supported [[Ebrahi]]'s claim to the [[Geharran royal family|throne]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. Members of the loyalists attempted to assassinate [[Meilarra]], a candidate for the throne supported by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
